_about: Public values only (PLAN.md §4.1). 'hooks' is the one webhook base (Q58): tools/build.py writes it into assets/js/config.js and the CSP in _headers, and tools/check.py allows it only there and refuses any nubius base. The Turnstile site key is public (Q66, LAUNCH.md step 1); a value starting PLACEHOLDER builds as empty, so the forms stay off, and tools/check.py --launch fails.
